column1: # README badges, in the order they appear. public and private: on by default for that visibility (yes or empty). needs:
# what must be true for the badge to be offered: owner (a GitHub name), a check key (that check is on), cran (going to
# CRAN). line: the badge, with {repository} (https://github.com/owner/package), {owner}, {package} and {site_url}.
# Keep the columns tab-separated, with no hash sign inside a cell (lists treat it as a comment).

column3: Shows whether the latest R CMD check on the default branch passed.
Tells readers how settled the package is. Starts at experimental; change it with usethis::use_lifecycle_badge().
Shows the test coverage. Needs the coverage check, and a Codecov account linked to the repository.
Shows the version on CRAN. Says "not published" until the package is accepted.
How many times the package was downloaded from CRAN each month.
The version built on R-universe, where people can install it from before or instead of CRAN. Needs an R-universe set up for your GitHub name.
A small credit that links to launchR.
